title: LEG ENGINE
why: Fully recharged, legs recovered, upper body sore from yesterday, 60 minutes, and you want intensity — so today is a hard leg + running day while your pressing and pulling muscles recover. Heavy double front squats and RDLs on fresh legs, fast quarter-mile intervals (your strength), then a swing-lunge-squat chipper to empty the tank. No overhead pressing, no rows.

blocks.title: WARM-UP
blocks.text: 3 min easy jog to prime the legs · Leg swings 10/leg · Ankle rocks 10/side · Deep goblet pry ×5 · Walking lunges 6/leg · 10 bodyweight squats · 10 easy swings (16 kg).

blocks.title: HEAVY LEGS
blocks.text: 6 front squats straight into 8 Romanian deadlifts, then rest 90s. 1–2 in reserve. Elbows high on the squat, flat-back hinge on the RDL. All legs and hips, nothing on your sore pressing muscles. Use the COUNTDOWN timer set to 14:00 if you want a cap.

blocks.title: RUN INTERVALS
blocks.text: Five hard quarter-miles with a 90-second walk between each. Legs are fresh and you're a strong runner, so attack these. Pace them so rep 5 is as fast as rep 1.

blocks.title: LEG CHIPPER
blocks.text: Flow through all three, minimal rest, then rest ~60s and repeat. Target 4 rounds (3 if time's tight). Leave one clean rep in the tank on the final set. Empty the legs.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Walk it down 2 min · Stretch 30s each: quads, hamstrings, hip flexors, calves, glutes.
